name: Alethiometer replica from His Dark Materials

mentions.name: Alethiometer replica from His Dark Materials
mentions.description: A physical, working replica of the alethiometer from Philip Pullman's His Dark Materials, remade with knowledge of both trilogies. It uses a single moving needle instead of the original three hands and moving needle, with a case and dial made from wood and aluminium (chosen as a period-appropriate 'wonder material' for the 1920s setting). The mechanism is controlled by 8mm steppers; remaining work includes finishing and painting the case and dial, shrinking the controlling mechanism, and designing a voice->text->inference->output pipeline that maps to 36 symbols.
